paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: figures/ablation_title.pdf
model_annotation: This bar chart compares the F1 scores of different variations of the MADLLM model across six datasets. The horizontal axis lists the datasets, namely SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, while the vertical axis represents the F1 Score in percentage, ranging from 60 to 100 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. The chart is divided into grouped bars, with each group representing a dataset and containing four bars corresponding to different model variations: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). The bars within each group are positioned side by side, allowing for direct comparison between the model variations. The F1 scores for MADLLM range from approximately 93 for SMD to around 74 for WADI, while the other model variations exhibit lower scores, with MADLLM w/o prompt pool consistently having the lowest scores across all datasets, ranging from around 78 for SMD to about 64 for WADI. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars, and no bars are visually emphasized.
